[quote=alkiragunya;59347958][i]Camelos e cobre por ferro e aço, certamente...é interessante,  nos ajudaria em...

 [/i]
Ngarrajin (o mascarado) tira de suas vestes uma espécie de rifle por ação de parafuso, um tento rudimentar, como se fosse feito a mão, com alguns detalhes tribais de serpentes e outros animais ao longo da coronha, e uma mira rudimentar feita com osso, o cano metálico mostra certa idade, mas não tanto.
[i]Mawarlu, uma arma que nós fizemos, provavelmente iria imaginar que usamos metais para meras ferramentas, o que não é mentira de fato, mas também usamos para armas, nas comunidades mais ao norte , onde são mais semi nômades, eles se dão ao tempo de minerar e criar armas, achei que vocês pensariam ser interessante.
[/i]
O mascarado guarda o rifle e gesticula ao conselho para continuarem.
[i]Se, isso for tudo, estamos felizes em sermos seus aliados e parceiros de comércio.[/i]
Tjarrampa diz.
[i]Camels and copper for iron and steel, certainly... it's interesting, it would help us in...[/i]

Ngarrajin (the masked man) takes out of his robes a kind of bolt-action rifle, a rudimentary sight, as if it were handmade, with some details of snake tribes and other animals along the crown, and a rudimentary sight made of bone, the metal barrel shows some age, but not that much.

[i]Mawarlu, a gun we made , we would probably imagine that we use metals for mere tools, which is not a lie in fact, but we also use them for weapons, in the communities further north, where they are more semi-nomadic, they take the time to mine and create weapons, I thought you would find them interesting[/i].

The masked man puts away the rifle and gestures to the council to continue.

[i]If that's all, we are happy to be your allies and trading partners.[/i]

Tjarrampa says.[/quote]

[i]There would defenitly be people that would be interested in such handmade guns...[/i] Olaf muthers silently, mostly to himself.

Tau turns fully towards to Akiragunya council to propperly address them.
[i]It is wonderful to hear this, there is an old waystation in a place we call 'The traders coridor', east of your southern most lands, that we can repair and expand to use as a meeting place for traders from both nations to do trade more easely, be it small or big, tough we should make propper documents to sign that lays out the terms and conditions, with copies being kept by both sides to ensure that no induvidual may easely twist the agreement to serve ill intent[/i]

[i]We also need to know when you hold council here next, so that a proper representative of our own council can sign the documents together with you, as to make it propper and binding in our peoples eyes[/i]
Djalu says.
[i]Is there a sett schedule or time for when you hold council here?[/i]
